## Name the stage and standard

First name the stage. Are you exploring, deciding, reviewing, submitting or acting, or preparing to archive or hand over? Quality cannot be tested until the work has a purpose and a gate.

## Try this now

1. State the audience, decision and authority.
2. Run the stage rubric.
3. Separate critical failures from optional improvements.
4. Fix safety, integrity, approval, evidence and reproducibility failures first.
5. Defer work that addresses no failed test or requirement.
6. Obtain the named review decision.

## What to take when asking

Bring the stage, acceptance criteria, evidence for each test, failed checks, optional refinements and one decision request.

## Stop or change route

Do not proceed because of deadline alone when a critical check fails. Do not delay because an unrequested improvement remains imaginable.

## You are moving again when

Every critical test passes or has an authorised disposition, and the next gate is recorded.

Use the [good-enough rubric](../checklists/good-enough-rubric.qmd) and the relevant phase checklist.
